rules.text: An incoming STOP blocks voice and SMS across the owning account. The receiving business number is evidence only.
rules.why: Campaigns on another business number in the same account consult the same suppression.

rules.text: A number or a separate agent does not create its own STOP boundary.
rules.instead: Use separate accounts when independent consent domains are required. Never route around a suppression.

rules.text: Preview local contact rules before outreach. Report the reason when a recipient is held and resolve the underlying policy or missing data.
Add a do-not-contact entry for all channels, voice or SMS. Check the selected owner and recipient before any change.
The following normalised whole-message keywords trigger opt-out. A keyword inside an ordinary sentence does not trigger this matcher. Respect other expressions of withdrawal through your own process.
Check contact hours or inspect the suppression list for the account.
If feature_paused is returned, contact-list changes are unavailable. Existing opt-outs continue to apply.

Keyword STOP works independently. AI recognition of a sender’s clear objection in a verified incoming SMS is off by default. Customers have no switch for it. Where enabled on eligible automatic replies, it blocks calls and texts account-wide and may send one goodbye.

On GET /v1/contact-suppressions, business_number alone selects keyword evidence. Add source=attributed for keyword and AI entries. To correct an eligible AI mistake, the Owner or account key sends phone_number, channel=all, current review_version and a reason to POST /v1/contact-suppressions/ai-corrections. Reload on review_changed. Keyword STOP and independent restrictions stay locked. Correction never supplies consent.
